import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Normalize Category (case variant "office supplies" -> "Office Supplies")
    if "Category" in df.columns:
        # strip whitespace
        s = df["Category"].astype(object)
        # only process string values
        mask = s.notna()
        s_clean = s[mask].astype(str).str.strip()
        allowed = ["Electronics", "Accessories", "Furniture", "Office Supplies"]
        lower_map = {v.lower(): v for v in allowed}
        s_clean = s_clean.str.lower().map(lower_map).fillna(s_clean)
        df.loc[mask, "Category"] = s_clean
    # Remove exact duplicate rows (Order_ID uniqueness / exact_duplicate_rows=2)
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # drop missing group keys
    if "Category" in df.columns:
        df = df[df["Category"].notna() & (df["Category"].astype(str).str.strip() != "")]
    # count orders per Category
    vc = df["Category"].value_counts(dropna=True)
    # return as plain dict with int values
    return {str(k): int(v) for k, v in vc.items()}
